releases.title: Claude Opus 4.8
releases.summary: Upgrade to Opus 4.7 with gains across benchmarks, at the same price. Fast mode runs ~2.5× faster and 3× cheaper; only model to complete every Super-Agent case end-to-end; strongest computer-use / browser-agent model (84% on Online-Mind2Web). Adds effort control on claude.ai and 'dynamic workflows' in Claude Code (plan, then run hundreds of parallel subagents in one session).
